definition.content:
## Cyberhaven Audit Trail
*Who did what in the Cyberhaven console and API*

This dashboard provides an overview of the Cyberhaven audit trail: who did what in the Cyberhaven console and API, including logins, policy and role changes, deletions, exports and API key activity.

Data source: Cyberhaven Audit Log streaming destination (`source:cyberhaven cyberhaven.logtype:cyberhaven-audit`).

**Tips**
- Use the filters at the top to narrow down the data shown.
- Use the timeframe selector in the upper-right corner to change the default timeframe.
- Clone this dashboard to rearrange, modify, and add widgets.
High-level view of Cyberhaven audit activity: total events, unique actors, logins, searches, deletes and exports, plus trends over time by action type, severity and actor.

definition.title: Audit Events Over Time by Action Type
Audit Events Over Time by Severity

definition.content: Triage view of audit events by severity (informational, low, medium) and by outcome (allowed, successful, failed, rejected), including failed logins.
Raw list of recent audit events. Click a record to drill into its details.
Account-takeover investigation surface: logins, password, MFA and SSO resets, and who is authenticating most often.

search.query: source:cyberhaven cyberhaven.logtype:cyberhaven-audit (@action_type:login OR @action_type:email_invite_login OR @action_type:reset_password OR @action_type:reset_mfa OR @action_type:reset_provider) $Actor $Actor-Type $Cyberhaven-Tenant $Outcome $Object-Type

definition.content: Change-control view of create, update and delete activity, the object types most affected, and the actors behind deletes and updates.
Privilege-escalation surface: role, scope and deployment-group assignments, and activity by API keys and system actors.
Who is acting and from where: top actors, source IPs, user agents, tenant domains, actor types and geographic distribution.
Volume breakdown of what is being done and to what: top action types, objects acted on, and action x object x actor combinations.

definition.title: Action Type x Object Type x Actor (Top Combinations)
